name: InitEntryPool
evidence: sets stride to size+8, allocates stride*count bytes, chains every entry into the free list and clears the live list

name: ShutDownEntryPool
evidence: empty; ShutDownScriptValuePools calls it on each of the five entry pools InitScriptValuePools set up with InitEntryPool

name: PopPoolFreeEntry
evidence: takes the first entry off the pool's free list (collecting with func_0011AB58 first when empty), pushes it on the used list and returns its payload address

name: TakePoolEntry
evidence: takes an entry off the pool's free list (func_0011C1D8) and clears it to the pool's entry size

name: GetPoolEntry
evidence: returns mem + index * stride

name: MarkPoolLiveEnd
evidence: copies the live list head into the live mark

name: ClearPoolLiveStates
evidence: walks the live list and zeroes each entry's state word at +4

name: ReleaseDeadPoolEntries
evidence: after the live mark, unlinks entries whose word at +4 is 0 onto the free list, calling the pool's removeCallback on each

name: GetPoolEntryPayload
evidence: returns the address 8 bytes past a pool entry's header

name: GetPoolEntryHeader
evidence: returns the address 8 bytes before a payload

name: IsPoolEntryUnmarked
evidence: returns whether the state word at +4 of a payload's entry header (GetPoolEntryHeader) is 0, the word MarkPoolEntryUsed sets to 1; DrainMarkStacks tests it before marking

name: MarkPoolEntryUsed
evidence: sets the state word at +4 of the entry header of a payload to 1, the word ReleaseDeadPoolEntries tests

name: CopyKeyedValueChain
evidence: copies the key, clones the value with CloneValue and recurses over next, making a new keyed node for each

name: NewKeyedValue
evidence: takes a 0x10-byte node from the pool D_0025C290, clears it and sets its value unset

name: DestroyKeyedValue
evidence: the keyed pool's removeCallback: destroys the node's value with DestroyValue (flags 2)

name: AcquireVectorAPayload
evidence: takes a 16-byte block from the pool D_0062C558 (zeroed), running func_0011AB58 first when the pool is empty; the tag 0x16 allocator

name: AddRefVectorAPayload
evidence: adds one to the byte count at (addr - pool origin) >> 4 in D_0027B300[0] and returns it

name: ReleaseVectorAPayload
evidence: subtracts one from that byte count and returns the block to the pool D_0062C558 when it reaches 0

name: AcquireMatrixPayload
evidence: takes a 0x40-byte block from the pool D_0062C568, zeroed, collecting first when empty; the tag 0x17 allocator

name: AddRefMatrixPayload
evidence: adds one to the count at (addr - pool origin) >> 6 in D_0027B300[1] and returns it

name: ReleaseMatrixPayload
evidence: subtracts one from that count and returns the block to the pool D_0062C568 at 0

name: FreeMatrixPayload
evidence: hands a block straight back to the pool D_0062C568 through func_001B5F28

name: AcquireVectorBPayload
evidence: takes a 16-byte block from the pool D_0062C578; the tag 0x18 allocator

name: AddRefVectorBPayload
evidence: adds one to the count at (addr - pool origin) >> 4 in D_0027B300[2] and returns it

name: ReleaseVectorBPayload
evidence: subtracts one from that count and returns the block to the pool D_0062C578 at 0

name: AcquirePairPayload
evidence: takes an 8-byte block from the pool D_0062C588; the tag 0x19 allocator (two floats)

name: AddRefPairPayload
evidence: adds one to the count at (addr - pool origin) >> 3 in D_0027B300[3] and returns it

name: ReleasePairPayload
evidence: subtracts one from that count and returns the block to the pool D_0062C588 at 0

name: AcquireTriplePayload
evidence: takes a 12-byte block from the pool D_0062C598; the tag 0x1A allocator (three floats)

name: AddRefTriplePayload
evidence: adds one to the count at (addr - pool origin) / 12 in D_0027B310 and returns it

name: ReleaseTriplePayload
evidence: subtracts one from that count and returns the block to the pool D_0062C598 at 0

name: InitPayloadPools
evidence: sets up the five payload pools (entry sizes 0x10, 0x40, 0x10, 0x8, 0xC) with func_001B5DD0 and allocates a count byte for each entry in D_0027B300[0..3] and D_0027B310

name: ShutDownPayloadPools
evidence: empty; ShutDownScriptValuePools calls it where InitScriptValuePools calls InitPayloadPools
